meaning: Profile or provider request exists but has not been reviewed.
public_visibility: Hidden from public lists unless owner explicitly allows a missing-supply placeholder.

meaning: Provider has claimed or submitted the profile, but documents are not validated.
public_visibility: May appear only with no verification claim and clear missing-proof state.
required_evidence: Provider email or phone confirmation plus claim request
blocked_claims: Verified credential, public endorsement, review score

meaning: Documents or profile materials were reviewed for completeness, but official source match may still be pending.
public_visibility: May appear with document-reviewed label, not license-verified label.
required_evidence: Business documents, insurance, certificate, portfolio, or official document copy as relevant
blocked_claims: Official license verified unless checked against the official source

meaning: License or registry status was checked against the relevant official or professional source.
public_visibility: May appear with verified status and source/review date.
who_can_set: Verification reviewer plus owner approval for sensitive professions
required_evidence: Official registry source, license number when public, screenshot or source note, review date
allowed_claims: Verified against named source and date
blocked_claims: Legal, tax, finance, or appraisal advice as site advice
applies_to: lawyers, appraisers, realtors, contractors, regulated professions

meaning: Owner approved the profile, copy, disclosure, and lead routing for publication.
public_visibility: Visible according to the approved category and page rules.
required_evidence: Completed profile, verification status, disclosure state, lead destination, last review date
allowed_claims: Approved profile facts and contact paths
blocked_claims: Any claim not supported by evidence

meaning: Profile failed review, lacks proof, conflicts with policy, or is not appropriate for NadLan.
Profile was previously public but is paused due to stale data, dispute, complaint, or commercial issue.
public_visibility: Hidden or shown only as unavailable in admin, not public.
required_evidence: Suspension reason, date, reviewer, restoration condition
blocked_claims: Any public recommendation or lead routing

meaning: Profile was once approved but review date is too old or contact path failed.
public_visibility: Can remain visible only if low-risk and clearly not marked as freshly verified; sensitive categories should be hidden until review.
required_evidence: Last verification date, failed contact test, stale alert
blocked_claims: Fresh verification, current availability, active recommendation
